Planning Document: Car Parking Standards

Clause 4.1: Residential dwellings require 1 parking space per dwelling.
Clause 4.2: Retail premises require 1 space per 25 square metres of floor area.
Clause 4.3: Office developments require 1 space per 40 square metres.
Clause 4.4: Parking spaces must be minimum 2.4m x 5.5m in size.
